sources.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B model card
sources.evidence: Post-trained text-only causal model; nominal language-model counts are 2.4T total and 95B activated. Native context is 262,144, extendable to 1,010,000. Thinking is required. Hosted Qwen3.8-Max adds vision, non-thinking, longer default context and built-in tools.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 official repository and release news
sources.evidence: Identifies the Qwen team at Alibaba Group; the 2026-08-12 news item explicitly announces Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max License
sources.evidence: Custom Qwen3.8-Max license permits weights use and redistribution subject to its conditions; this is not Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM; 92 decoder layers in repeated 3 linear-attention/1 full-attention groups; 512 routed experts with top-10 routing and a shared expert. One MTP layer; untied embeddings; BF16 and no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Official chat template
sources.evidence: Accepts text content; rejects disabling thinking; serializes tools, assistant function calls and tool responses.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index and indexed shard headers
sources.evidence: Index lists 1,609 tensors in 213 shards and 4,892,365,451,008 data bytes. HTTP Range reads of all 213 headers (198,328 bytes including length prefixes; no weight payloads) independently summed 2,446,182,725,504 BF16 elements. All indexed tensors are model weights, norms, attention A_log/dt_bias parameters, or MTP parameters; no quantization scales, packed integers or unrelated buffers. Decoder subtotal is 2,419,804,697,984; MTP subtotal is 26,378,027,520.

sources.title: Official repository Hub metadata
sources.evidence: At revision 207bd685a7e3696cfaff12ded7c6a7ea0f88c996, safetensors metadata reports 2,446,182,725,504 parameters, entirely BF16. Repository is public and ungated. Repository creation on August 8 is not used as release evidence.

sources.title: MTP grouped gate/up tensor header
sources.evidence: Header-only HTTP Range access: mtp.layers.0.mlp.experts.gate_up_proj has BF16 shape [512,4096,8192], or 17,179,869,184 parameters.

sources.title: MTP grouped down tensor header
sources.evidence: Header-only HTTP Range access: mtp.layers.0.mlp.experts.down_proj has BF16 shape [512,8192,2048], or 8,589,934,592 parameters.

sources.title: Remaining MTP tensor headers
sources.evidence: Header-only HTTP Range access establishes the other 17 MTP tensors, totaling 608,223,744 BF16 parameters; with the two grouped expert tensors, MTP contributes 26,378,027,520 parameters.

name.note: Display formatting of the official Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B name.

family.note: Qwen3.8 belongs to the Qwen model family.

release_date.note: Explicit public availability announcement, rather than repository creation/upload time.

parameters_b.note: Exact full checkpoint count in billions, including MTP. Decoder 2419.804697984B + MTP 26.37802752B. Header shapes reconcile with Hub metadata and byte size; no packed weights or scale tensors. The model card uses nominal 2.4T.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-disclosed nominal language-model activation count, retained with decoder scope; not an exact MTP-inclusive count. No active count was inferred from non-embedding totals.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE with 512 routed experts, 10 routed + 1 shared active per layer; 69 Gated DeltaNet layers and 23 gated-attention layers, plus one MTP layer. The moe category is retained, with hybrid attention detailed here.

context_window.note: Native checkpoint context. The card separately documents extension to 1,010,000 tokens.

modalities.note: This open checkpoint is explicitly text-only.

reasoning.note: Thinking is mandatory; reasoning effort is configurable.

tool_call.note: Official template supports function definitions, assistant calls and tool responses.

description.value: Open-weight text-only reasoning model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated attention and sparse MoE layers. The full checkpoint includes a multi-token prediction module; the hosted Qwen3.8-Max version adds further features.
description.note: Replaces the ambiguous twin claim with the documented checkpoint/service distinction and exact architecture.

patch.description: Open-weight text-only reasoning model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated attention and sparse MoE layers. The full checkpoint includes a multi-token prediction module; the hosted Qwen3.8-Max version adds further features.
patch.notes: Full BF16 checkpoint: 2446.182725504B parameters, comprising decoder 2419.804697984B and auxiliary MTP 26.37802752B. The official 2.4T/95B labels are nominal language-model figures; 95B active applies to the decoder, not an asserted MTP-inclusive inference total. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention MoE; 262,144 native context, extendable to 1,010,000.

summary: All 14 fields verified. Correct nominal 2400B to the exact 2446.182725504B full BF16 checkpoint count; retain nominal 95B active with decoder scope and expose MTP separately. Clarify hybrid attention and the hosted Max distinction. Release is explicitly confirmed as 2026-08-12.
